Q1.rationale: Base [7] bars disclosure to any third party, which would include government agencies, but base [11] carves out disclosures required by law or any competent authority, and no exception covers voluntary reports of violations.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: V2 deletes base [20], which is unrelated to reporting; base [7] still restricts disclosure to third parties, with only the required-by-law or competent-authority carve-out in [11].
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: V3 replaces base [14] with identical wording on indefinite duration, so base [7] still restricts disclosure to third parties, with only the required-by-law or competent-authority carve-out in [11].
Q3.label: Entailment
